summary: Pueblo County SO Capt. Leide DeFusco (43) and retired Pueblo PD Capt. John Barger (63, pilot) killed when their single-engine Piper Super Cruiser (N3031M) crashed during a marijuana-crop surveillance flight over the Wet Mountains ~5 mi below St Charles Peak, just north of Cisneros Trail; Alpine mission 12-81 assisted Custer County SAR with the body recovery
responding_agency: Custer County SAR; Alpine Rescue Team (assist); Pueblo County SAR; Fremont County SAR; U.S. Forest Service; Flight for Life
notes: MERGED run 548: officer.com/Chieftain account — flight followed up an Aug 15 marijuana-plantation raid; contact lost ~9:40 a.m. Friday; Flight for Life spotted smoke and used it as a beacon, locating the smoldering wreckage ~7:10 p.m. ~5 mi below St Charles Peak just north of Cisneros Trail, San Isabel NF (Custer County); ~60 SAR personnel (Pueblo/Custer/Fremont county SAR, USFS, FBI); NTSB notified; recovery resumed Saturday. 2026-09-20 (run 934): Pueblo Chieftain story (byline Nick Bonham, via kathrynsreport.com reprint) merged — corroborates 2012-08-31 DeFusco/Barger surveillance-plane crash ~4–5 mi below St. Charles Peak, Custer County; ~60 searchers (sheriff's office, Custer/Fremont counties, forest service, FBI); Flight for Life located wreckage.
